program_name: Bitget Wallet Affiliate Program (Card + swap + perps commissions)
application_conditions: 'You can apply as long as you have your own social media account or community' and are willing to promote Bitget Wallet; no follower minimum stated; application form at web3.bitget.com/affiliate/application (not opened); referral links and codes in the app's Referral Center. Programme 'may not be available in certain regions' (none named); must comply with local laws.
paid_action: Card: one-time bonus on a referred user's first qualifying ("effective", region-dependent) card payment, a commission on physical-card activation, and an ongoing commission on card spending. Also 60% of swap trading fees (selected pairs) and 20% of perps trading fees from referred users, no minimum volume. Secondary commission: +10% of the Card commissions earned by affiliates one refers.
validation_conditions: A user counts as a referral if they apply through the affiliate's link or enter the referral code within 7 days of opening their card. Definition of an effective new card payment varies by region. On-page terms allow programme changes.

commission.model_note: Card tiers: Tier 1 (default) 2 USDT per new card payment, 20% physical-card activation commission, 0.10% of card spend; Tier 2 (≥ 5 card referrals) 3 USDT / 20% / 0.15%; Tier 3 (≥ 20) 4 USDT / 20% / 0.20%; VIP 1–3 (invite only, ≥ 100 card referrals to apply) 5 USDT / 30–50% / 0.20–0.30%. Tiers 1–3 upgrade automatically. Swaps 60% and perps 20% of trading fees. Base of the 20–50% "physical card activation" commission (card price?) not defined on the page.
commission.tiers_note: amount = Tier 1 new-card-payment bonus; tier thresholds by number of card referrals (5 / 20 / 100 for VIP application).

revenue_share.included_products: Card spending (0.10–0.30%), physical-card activation (20–50%), swap fees (60%, selected pairs), perps fees (20%); second-level 10% of referred affiliates' Card commissions.
revenue_share.exclusions: Only selected swap pairs are eligible; effective card payment definition varies by region.

payout.method: Credited to the in-app Reward Account (Home > Reward(s) Account); withdrawable from the app; currency beyond USDT bonuses not stated
payout.frequency: Distributed to the Reward Account the following day

rules_note: Blog-article programme page with an on-page Terms section (changes, eligibility, conditions, distribution); no separate affiliate agreement linked; date 2026-08-12 shown near the end of the article (not labelled). Legal entity not stated (footer © 2018-2024 Bitget Wallet). Two-level structure (10% secondary commission) to be weighed against editorial independence. Related official pages surfaced but not read: card-referral-program blog, Global Payment Partner Program, help centre article 513 (invite friends).
allowed_countries_note: 'May not be available in certain regions' — no list. Card itself: EEA+UK per the card record.

evidence.title: Bitget Wallet Affiliate Program (official blog article; date 2026-08-12 shown in the article)
